value.rationale: Directed triangle and directed quadrilateral counts are canonical random-tournament diagnostics whose joint dependence is mathematically natural. The full finite exact correlation sqrt((4n-12)/(4n-11)) and exact residual-variance fraction 1/(4n-11) quantify a surprising asymptotically perfect linear relation and provide a sharp, usable null-model benchmark, beyond standard marginal expectations or arbitrary isolated coefficients.
